title: Regulation and reformulation: how the EU Paints Directive shaped volatile organic compound emissions from UK decorative paints
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EA00134J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lidia Kristia Alfanti, Amber May Yeoman, Andrew Robert Rickard, David Shaw, Martyn William Ward, Sarah Julia Moller, Alastair Charles Lewis
A novel VOC profiling of modern wall paints shows how reformulation driven by EU regulation has reduced overall VOC emissions and shifted formulations from solvent-based to water-based, reducing their potential to form secondary pollutants.
